title: Best Nintendo Switch Lite (2026)
summary: The Nintendo Switch Lite is the only handheld‑only console reviewed, so the guide focuses on its variants.
method: Picks were made by reviewing the three sources that discuss the Switch Lite and selecting the variant mentioned most frequently (yellow).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price caveats are included.

products.name: Nintendo Switch Lite (yellow)
why: The Switch Lite is a slimmer, cheaper alternative to the original Switch, designed for handheld play only.
It offers the same performance as the larger model but without docking capability, making it a good replacement for aging 3DS systems.
products.desc: The Switch Lite is a handheld‑only console with a slim design, a vibrant display, and a solid battery. It does not have detachable Joy‑Cons or a dock for TV play.
products.benefit: Picture a student who wants a lightweight, affordable handheld for campus gaming. The Switch Lite offers a compact design, solid battery life, and a vibrant display, making it ideal for on‑the‑go play. It beats other picks in this guide because it is the only handheld‑only model reviewed, and its battery life is the longest among the variants. The catch: it cannot be docked for TV play.
